prompt.zh-TW: 佩佩的「日暮文具社」這個月賣出一批筆記本。從損益表最上面的營業收入出發，扣掉哪一項之後，得到的第一層利益是營業毛利？
prompt.en: Pei’s shop Sunset Stationery sold a batch of notebooks this month. Starting from revenue at the top of the income statement, what is deducted to reach the first profit level, gross profit?

text.zh-TW: 營業成本：賣出去那些筆記本的進貨成本
text.en: Cost of sales: the cost of the notebooks that were sold

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。收入減掉賣出商品本身的成本，就是營業毛利。
feedback.en: Nice work. Revenue less the cost of the goods sold is gross profit.

text.zh-TW: 營業成本加上店員薪水、運費等所有費用
text.en: Cost of sales plus all expenses such as staff wages and delivery

short.en: Cost of sales plus all expenses

feedback.zh-TW: 你知道薪水與運費也要扣，這點沒錯，只是那是下一層。營業毛利只扣商品本身的成本，薪水與運費要到營業利益那一層才扣。
feedback.en: You know that wages and delivery have to be deducted too, and that is right; they just belong to the next level. Gross profit deducts only the cost of the goods themselves; wages and delivery are deducted at operating profit.

feedback.zh-TW: 所得稅確實是損益表上會扣的項目，這點沒錯。不過它在最後一層才扣：從稅前淨利扣掉所得稅才得到本期淨利。
feedback.en: Income tax is indeed deducted on the income statement, that much is right. But it comes at the very last level: profit before tax less income tax gives profit for the period.

explanation.zh-TW: 五層利益從上往下，每一層處理一類項目。第一層是{{term:tm_g8p4w1rz}}：{{term:tm_v3n8q2ye}}減掉{{term:tm_g5c2m8tw}}，所以是{{option:o_yxqy}}。{{option:o_e3jy}}多扣了下一層的銷管費用，{{option:o_9gt4}}則跳到了最後一層。
explanation.en: Each of the five levels deals with one kind of item. The first level is {{term:tm_g8p4w1rz}}: {{term:tm_v3n8q2ye}} less {{term:tm_g5c2m8tw}}, so the answer is {{option:o_yxqy}}. {{option:o_e3jy}} also deducts the next level’s distribution costs and administrative expenses, and {{option:o_9gt4}} jumps to the last level.
